items.name: Filed: semaglutide/insulin icodec combination, once-weekly (type 2 diabetes)
items.claim: Novo Nordisk's R&D pipeline page lists a Filed-phase combination of GLP-1 analogue semaglutide and insulin icodec intended for once-weekly treatment of type 2 diabetes.
items.source_excerpt:
Filed Type 2 diabetes
A combination of GLP-1 analogue semaglutide and insulin icodec intended for once-weekly treatment.

items.name: Phase 3: long-acting amylin analogue, once-weekly subcutaneous (obesity)
items.claim: Novo Nordisk's R&D pipeline page lists a long-acting co-agonist of GLP-1 and amylin, and a long-acting amylin analogue, both for once-weekly subcutaneous administration in obesity.
items.source_excerpt:
A long-acting co-agonist of GLP-1 and amylin intended for once weekly subcutaneous injection
